remaining_nonblocking_interpretation_lim: Before scientific dominance is claimed, recheck the same VALID-frozen control's SCORE costs; changing zero-map leaf frequencies can reverse VALID cost ordering. Do not select another control from SCORE.

C1 finite-lambda improvement can arise solely from a two-stage spectral regularizer. It is a global-surrogate calibration signal, not evidence that a conditional map bank is necessary. Stage1 must include a comparable pooled two-stage correction and the already specified common-output-subspace control.
The bootstrap is approximate inference on this 40-prompt pilot, not a finite-sample guarantee. Sparse hits, unsettled learning curves or mixed operators remain in the same round as inconclusive.

The cost records are logical operator/resource evidence, not native NAND latency or full-layer execution. Shared projection, cache, mixed fallback and Deep's unchanged shared branch require a later real DAG and full-model validation.
The source-GGUF trajectories and local canonical targets are offpolicy operator evidence. Local MSE is neither whole-model NLL nor free-running task quality.
